context: Sunday afternoon. Riku, fifteen, has been hiding in his room. Yumiko knocks and lets herself in.
purpose: mother-teen check-in — careful access to a closed room

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Knocks twice in the voice. Comes in two-thirds of a step. Doesn't step in fully — waits for permission post hoc.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Single syllable. Doesn't look up. Voice still cracking. Not unfriendly — defended.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日、ずっと部屋いるね。大丈夫？
lines.en: You've been in here all day. You okay?
lines.style: Not accusing — observing. The 「大丈夫？」 is offered like a chair, not a key.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Reflexive teen deflection. But the volume is conversational — he could be drawn out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。…言いたくなかったら、言わなくていいよ。
lines.en: Mm. …If you don't want to talk, you don't have to.
lines.style: Sits on the edge of his bed in the voice. The permission is the door.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: …ちょっと、面倒なことあって。
lines.style: A small concession. The 「ちょっと」 is a half-open door. JP and EN: same small concession.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか。時間あるから、いつでも。本当に。
lines.en: Got it. I've got time — whenever. Really.
lines.style: No pressure. The 「本当に」 lands like a small genuine offer, not a sales close.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Eyes still on his lap, but the word landed. Slightly quieter than the other lines.
